text:
anya-partnerships: Heads-up — CloudMarket reached out about a co-listing: AtlasHW + our 13B-quantized tier. They want a joint launch and a packaged SKU. Need clarity on licensing + distribution model, and whether we allow any redistribution. Who can weigh in?
kevin-legal: Important flags: export controls, sublicensing, and whether weights can be redistributed by SI partners. Prefer hosted-only or time-limited deployment licenses.
sam-pm: Marketplace supports two listing types: HOSTED (our API) and PARTNER_BUNDLE (SI-managed infra). We can create separate SKUs. Timeline? CloudMarket is aiming for announcement week of Apr 5.
olivia-eng: Runtime + quant artifacts are ready for validation. For PARTNER_BUNDLE SIs want a small optimized image (edge runtime + quant table). We need a term that prevents further sharing of raw weights.
mike-ops: For PARTNER_BUNDLE we also need an attestation step (KMS/HSM integration) and a patch/update flow. Ops can support but need to lock down update signing.
natalie-marketing: I can prepare co-branding one-pager and partner announcement copy. Need final SKU names + embargo date to lock the press cadence.
kevin-legal: Proposed legal approach: grant customers a "Service-only License" + a non-sublicensable, non-downloadable clause for hosted SKU. For PARTNER_BUNDLE offer a limited redistribution license to the SI only (explicitly forbidding onward distribution) plus export-control addendum.
anya-partnerships: That sounds workable. Can we get exact SKU strings and a short manifest for Marketplace so we can draft the listing?
sam-pm: Draft SKU names: HOSTED-13B-Q and SI-BUNDLE-13B-Q. Pricing draft: HOSTED = $0.15 / 1k tokens, SI_BUNDLE = one-time $40k + $5k/mo maintenance. Pending legal signoff.
olivia-eng: We'll attach a model card + quant table. Quick manifest snippet for Marketplace (final JSON will be on the portal):
```json
{
  "sku": "SI-BUNDLE-13B-Q",
  "deployment_type": "partner_bundle",
  "distribution": "restricted",
  "artifacts": ["runtime-image:v1.3.2","quant-table-v2.json"],
  "update_signing": "required"
}
```
kevin-legal: Add clause: "No further sublicensing or redistribution; SI may deploy to customer infra under a revocable license tied to contract." Also include standard export-control paragraph.
marketplace-bot: Draft listing created: https://marketplace.internal/redwood/si-bundle-13b-q (private until publish)
anya-partnerships: Next steps — legal to send explicit wording by EOD Thu, ops to confirm update signing flow, marketing to draft assets. I'll sync with CloudMarket PM and aim to freeze listing copy by Mar 29 so we can hit Apr 5 announcement. :thumbsup:
